Typhoon Fung-Wong (2025): Rapid Report

Lincole Jiang, Majd Abid, Lawrence Chillrud, G. Brooke Anderson, Robbie M. Parks

2026-10-23

Summary

Data status: Provisional — not yet reanalyzed (US-PROVISIONAL)

Typhoon Fung-Wong (2025) was active from 2025-11-04 06:00:00 to 2025-11-13 18:00:00 UTC. Based on IBTrACS data obtained 10/23/2026, 22,260,904 people experienced tropical cyclone-force (>= 17.49 m/s) winds and 2,821,868 people experienced hurricane-force (>= 32.90 m/s) winds across Philippines, Taiwan, Province of China. No areas experienced Category 5 winds.
